name: Ingredient Party Game
subtitle: Snack or Shampoo? Trivia
promotionalText: Snack or shampoo? Guess everyday products from their ingredients. Play solo or in teams, reveal clues, steal points, and finish with a surprising trivia showdown.
description:
Snack or shampoo? Candy or car wax? Find out how well you know the ingredients in everyday products.

Ingredient Party Game turns product labels into a trivia night for friends and family. Start with three ingredients, choose your answer, and reveal extra clues when you need them. Fewer clues mean more points.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Play solo or gather up to four teams around one device.
- Choose 3, 5, or 8 rounds per team.
- Pick Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty.
- Turn the answer timer, steals, music, and sound effects on or off.
- Choose team colors and let the game shuffle the turn order.

GUESS WHAT IS IN YOUR STUFF
Explore food, beauty, cleaning, children's products, and household items, or mix the books for a little of everything. The What Is Toilet Paper? category adds true-or-false trivia with unexpected facts.

MORE THAN A MULTIPLE-CHOICE QUIZ
Select an ingredient to read its definition without spending points. Reveal another clue for a point, learn about unusual ingredients after each answer, and try to steal a missed question from another team. Scores grow as the game progresses, with a double-point final round and a trivia finale where you risk game points, never money. Optional silly dares add a lighthearted finish.

ONE DEVICE, EVERYONE INCLUDED
Pass the device between turns on iPhone or iPad, or play together on Apple TV with the remote. No separate player phones or online room codes are required. This is local solo and group play, not online multiplayer.

FREE TO PLAY, READY OFFLINE
All game categories and difficulty levels are included. No account, subscription, or in-app purchases. The questions, ingredient glossary, pictures, and sounds are included in the app for offline play. Optional links to Maeser's books and the privacy policy require internet access. Buying a book is never required to play or unlock anything.

Inspired by the Ingredient Dictionary book series by Maeser.

For entertainment and general education. Ingredient lists represent typical products, not a specific brand or current formulation. The game is not medical, allergy, or product-safety advice. Always read the actual product label. Never taste or mix household products as part of play.

IOS.description:
APPLE WATCH SOLO GAME
The included Watch app offers 85 ingredient puzzles, ingredient definitions, more clues, and four-choice answers. Scores and best streaks stay on your Watch. Browse the same six companion books and the full series in Books, with optional website links and QR codes. Watch play is solo and separate from the iPhone/iPad party game; scores do not sync between devices.
IOS.reviewNotes: APPLE WATCH: The embedded io.github.maeserbern.ingredientpartygame.watch app is included with this iOS build, not a separate store listing. Launch Ingredient Party on Watch, choose Play, use More for another clue, select Guess and then an answer. Scores and best streaks are stored locally. Scroll down on the start screen to Books to find all six companion books plus the series, including external links and QR codes. Buying a book never unlocks game content. Watch has its own solo puzzle format, not shared multiplayer or cross-device score sync.

privacyPolicyText: Ingredient Party Game does not collect or transmit personal data. There are no accounts, analytics tools, or advertising trackers. Sound and music preferences and a history of puzzles already shown are stored only on the device. The solo Apple Watch version also stores its scores and streaks locally on the Watch. These records are not sent to us or synced between devices. Gameplay works offline. Optional external book links and QR codes lead to websites with their own privacy practices. Buying a book never unlocks game content. Privacy policy and contact: https://maeserbern-ai.github.io/#privacy
reviewNotes:
BUSINESS MODEL: This game is entirely free. There is no login, paid feature, subscription, in-app purchase, advertising SDK, or remote content unlock. All categories, difficulty levels, and gameplay are included. Optional external book links promote the developer's companion books; purchases do not unlock app content.

TO TEST: Select Play, choose a book or Mix all books, select Solo or 2-4 teams and the desired rounds/options, then Start game. Choose team colors, continue through turn order, and select an answer. Select an ingredient for its definition or Next ingredient for a clue. Menu pauses the game. Multiplayer is local on one device; there is no server or online matchmaking.

iPhone/iPad use touch controls. Apple TV uses the Siri Remote focus/select controls. The iPhone/iPad build packages the game locally, including fonts, images, questions, glossary, and sounds. Internet is only needed when choosing an external book or privacy link.

The finale wagers only non-purchasable game points on trivia knowledge. There is no money, cash-out, real-world prize, lottery, or casino gameplay. Ingredient information is general educational trivia, not medical or safety advice.

Privacy policy: https://maeserbern-ai.github.io/#privacy
